title: Kaohsiung Mosque
geometryBasis: National Land Surveying and Mapping Center building linework, geographically matched to Wikidata Q10566876 and OpenStreetMap way 214093306.
sectionBasis: Three principal levels, with the tall dark green east portico and arched glazing seen in the exact Qualla view. The dome and minaret crowns follow the city's architectural description. The street approach stays open in front of the recessed entrance.
limitations: The e-Map footprint and the photo guide orientation and visible proportions. The roof height, dome scale, rear windows and smaller service wings are approximate.
